text: Rotate service credentials in stages. Create a new token, update consumers, verify traffic and revoke the previous token.
title: Service credential rotation

text: Credential expiry needs advance alerts, a named owner and a tested renewal process.
title: Expiry and renewal

text: A batch job uses credentials to read a database backup. Review the job account permissions.
title: Batch job permissions

text: Restore a database backup into an isolated environment and verify row counts, constraints and application checks.
title: Database restore rehearsal

text: A recovery plan must account for new transactions written after the last verified recovery point.
title: Recovery point review

text: Check replication lag and reconcile the source and target before a database migration.
title: Replication checks

text: Switch a small traffic cohort to the canary, compare errors and latency, and review the rollback condition.
title: Canary traffic change

text: Routing changes need observed DNS behavior and a plan for cached clients. Traffic may remain on the old destination.
title: DNS routing review

text: Name the next service owner and share the deployment report, remaining risks and follow-up tasks.
title: Operational handoff
